label: Twenty days of prayer for Elon Musk to have a radical visitation
description: Elon Musk is named in the surrounding passage: he calls for prayer that Musk be born again and radically on fire for Jesus, says the demon costumes Musk has worn show he needs instructing, and reports being told to pray over it for the next twenty days, at the end of which he expects a major turn of events in that man's life and a radical visitation from Jesus. Given 10 November 2024, so the window closes 30 November 2024.
aliases: pray over that for the next 20 days
elon must to be born again
